company_profile: Laerdal Medical makes healthcare education and resuscitation training products, and its Copenhagen centre builds digital learning and analytics for hospitals, emergency services and training institutions.
title: Data AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years turning structured healthcare and telecom data into production ML and LLM solutions, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds agentic analytics with LangGraph and LangChain, RAG and search integration, and LLM evaluation with tracing and observability. Works hands-on with SQL, PySpark and Databricks data pipelines and partners with product and business stakeholders to turn user needs into trusted features. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Agentic Learner Analytics Assistant
bullets: Built an agentic data analyst for training outcome data in LangChain, answering educator questions by writing SQL over a governed data model and combining results with statistical summaries.
Evaluated answers against analyst-written test questions with LLM evaluators and tracing, added guardrails on data access, and served it on Databricks with PySpark and FastAPI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data AI Engineer role in AI & Analytics at Laerdal Copenhagen. The closest thing to your agentic data analyst in my work is a multi-agent analytics chatbot I built on healthcare plan data, which answers business questions with PySpark and live charts. The thread through my career is turning large structured data into answers people can act on.

Laerdal helps hospitals and emergency services train people who save lives, and giving those organisations clear insight into how their learners are doing is work that matters to me. Most of my career has been in healthcare data. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

At United Health Group my analytics chatbot cut manual analysis by 98%, and I built evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators and tracing that reduced human review by 43%. Earlier I engineered SQL and PySpark pipelines that cut manual reporting effort by 95%. I would bring both the data foundation and the agent layer to your product team.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Like your work, it is about helping people learn, and it has taught me to build carefully for real users. I would welcome a conversation about your analytics platform.
